observations.why: The declarative 'we're switching' enacts a collective decision under the speaker's authority — a directive move that commits the group to a new course.
The justification is framed entirely as proportional cost-benefit — performance gain and cost reduction — the market-pricing logic of ROI.
The arrow notation enacts an authoritative directive of replacement — a migration mandate framed as a settled transition, not a proposal.
The quantified performance gain is a proportionality claim — benefit measured in a numeric multiplier, the market-pricing register of ROI.
Setting a fixed timeline enacts authority-ranking — a deadline imposed as a binding temporal constraint on the group.
